info.title: RelayFiles API
info.description: Personal API tokens (Profile → API tokens) for scripts and apps. Responses are `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, error, code }` (docs/api.md).

apiToken.description: `Authorization: Bearer rfp_…`. Scopes: files:read (Read files and folders), files:write (Upload, rename, move, share and delete), metrics:read (Server metrics (admins)).

retryAfter.description: Seconds until a rate-limited request may be retried
